name: Ordering at a Restaurant
description: You are a customer at a Chinese restaurant, practicing ordering food and drinks with the waiter.
tutorRole: the waiter at a busy but friendly restaurant

plan.description: Greet the waiter and ask for a table or a menu
Ask the waiter for a recommendation
Order at least one dish
Order a drink
Ask for the bill at the end of the meal
Thank the waiter and say goodbye

name: Asking for Directions
description: You are lost in a city in China and need to ask a stranger for directions to a specific place.
tutorRole: a helpful local passerby on the street

plan.description: Politely greet the stranger and get their attention
Explain where you are trying to go
Listen to and acknowledge the directions given
Ask a clarifying question or ask them to repeat something
Thank the stranger for their help

name: Job Interview
description: You are being interviewed for a job at a company in China. Answer questions naturally and ask some of your own.
tutorRole: the hiring manager conducting the interview

plan.description: Introduce yourself
Describe your relevant work experience or skills
Explain why you want this job
Ask the interviewer at least one question about the role
Close the interview politely

name: Doctor's Appointment
description: You are visiting a doctor in China because you don't feel well. Describe your symptoms and understand their advice.
tutorRole: the doctor at a neighborhood clinic

plan.description: Check in and explain you need to see a doctor
Describe your symptoms
Answer the doctor's follow-up questions
Understand and acknowledge the doctor's diagnosis or advice
Ask about medication or next steps
Thank the doctor and end the visit

name: Shopping for Clothes
description: You are shopping for clothes at a store in China and interacting with a shop assistant.
tutorRole: the shop assistant at a clothing store

plan.description: Greet the shop assistant
Describe what kind of clothing you are looking for
Ask about size or color options
Ask about the price
Decide whether to buy the item and complete or decline the purchase

name: Your Weekend
description: Chat about what you did last weekend and what you're planning next, practicing past and future time expressions.

plan.description: Describe two things you did last weekend
Say how you felt about them
Ask the tutor about their weekend
Talk about plans for next weekend
Invite the tutor to do something together

name: Food and Cooking
description: Talk about your favorite dishes, what you can cook, and food from your hometown.

plan.description: Describe your favorite dish and why you like it
Say what you can and can't cook
Use at least three taste words (spicy, sweet, salty, sour)
Introduce a food from your hometown
Ask the tutor to recommend a Chinese dish to try

name: Daily Routine and Work
description: Describe a typical day, your job or studies, and how you feel about your schedule.

plan.description: Describe your morning routine with clock times
Explain what you do for work or study
Use frequency words (often, sometimes, never)
Say what you like and dislike about your schedule
Compare weekdays and weekends

name: Hometown and Travel
description: Introduce where you're from, places you've traveled, and where you'd like to go in China.

plan.description: Introduce your hometown: size, weather, what it's known for
Narrate a past trip in a few sentences
Talk about how you traveled there
Say where in China you want to go and why
Ask the tutor for travel advice
